questions.question: How do I get into MTAV?
questions.answer: By invitation only: someone from your cooperative (an administrator or a member of your family) creates your account and you receive an email with a link to choose your password and complete your details. From then on you sign in with your email and password.

questions.question: How do I register my family's preferences?
questions.answer: In the Lottery section (sidebar) you'll see the units of your family's type. Order them from most to least desired: by dragging them, or with each unit's move up / move down buttons (they work with the keyboard too). You can check the project plan to locate each unit before deciding.

questions.question: Can I change my preferences later?
questions.answer: Yes, as many times as you like, until the moment the lottery runs. Once it does, they lock automatically and become part of the execution record.

questions.question: Who sees my family's preferences?
questions.answer: Only the members of your own family (everyone sees and edits the same order). No other family sees them — neither before nor after the lottery.

questions.question: How does the lottery work?
questions.answer: The system assigns all units at once based on the preferences: first it guarantees the least-favored family does as well as possible, and within that guarantee it maximizes overall satisfaction. The result is final: it cannot be edited or negotiated.

questions.question: Why do I only see some of the project's units?
questions.answer: Your family is assigned a unit type (e.g. "two bedrooms") and takes part in the lottery only for units of that type. The administration defines the types for each project.

questions.question: What if units are added or removed, or my family changes type?
questions.answer: Your preference list adjusts automatically: you don't lose the order you had already registered. It's still a good idea to review it after a change.

questions.question: How do I know which unit my family received?
questions.answer: Once the lottery runs, the result is visible in the Lottery section for the whole project: you'll see which unit each family received.

questions.question: Can I invite other members of my family?
questions.answer: Yes — only from your own family. Each invitee receives an email with their registration link and gets their own account. You'll find the invitation among your Quick Actions (the + button, top right).

questions.question: How do I confirm attendance to an event?
questions.answer: In the Events section, open the event: if it asks for confirmation, you can answer whether you're going. The confirmation list is visible to the whole project.

questions.question: How do I share photos or documents?
questions.answer: In the Gallery and Documents sections, anyone in the project can upload images, documents and audio. What you upload is associated with your name; you can edit its description or delete it.

questions.question: Can I change my email address?
questions.answer: Yes, yourself: tap your name (bottom of the sidebar) → Settings → Profile. The new address stays pending verification until you confirm from the link you receive; meanwhile your account keeps working with the previous address.

questions.question: I forgot my password, what do I do?
questions.answer: Use "forgot password" on the sign-in screen: you'll receive an email with a link to choose a new one.

questions.question: Can I change how the application looks?
questions.answer: Yes: under Settings → Appearance you choose light, dark or automatic mode, and among several color themes — including a high-contrast one for better readability.
